query: SELECT count(*) FROM licences WHERE capacity_licensed = 999

what_you_see: رموز بريدية من خمسة أرقام سقط صفرها الأول
query: SELECT count(*) FROM centres WHERE length(postal_code) <> 6

what_you_see: كلمات compliant وconditional وnon_compliant بدل الرموز
query: SELECT count(*) FROM inspections WHERE outcome NOT IN (SELECT code FROM codes_outcome)
SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE submitted_at < DATE '2000-01-01'

what_you_see: «غير محدد» بدل رمز الحي: فراغ متنكر
query: SELECT count(*) FROM centres WHERE district_code NOT IN (SELECT district_code FROM districts)
SELECT count(*) FROM inspections i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM licences l WHERE l.licence_no = i.licence_no)

what_you_see: طلب واحد صدرت له رخصتان ساريتان
query: SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT application_id) FROM licences WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM licences WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expiry_date < DATE '2026-10-31'

what_you_see: مدينة مسجلة لا تطابقها بادئة الرمز البريدي
query: SELECT count(*) FROM centres c JOIN cities ci USING (city_code) WHERE length(c.postal_code) = 6 AND substr(c.postal_code, 1, 2) <> ci.postal_prefix

what_you_see: حضانة منزلية مرخصة لأكثر من عشرة مقاعد
query: SELECT count(*) FROM licences l JOIN centres c USING (centre_id) WHERE c.centre_type = 'HOME' AND l.capacity_licensed > 10 AND l.capacity_licensed <> 999
